name: Clintar Dreamwalker
shortDescription: The Dream-bound witness awakened in the Stormrage Barrow Den; his physical and divided-spirit depictions are separate interpretive research art.
body: The Dream-bound witness awakened in the Stormrage Barrow Den; his physical and divided-spirit depictions are separate interpretive research art. The original research illustration is interpretive, not canonical model evidence; compare it with the relevant TBC client before approval.
